full: Qalam is a free learning app. It gives lessons, worksheets to print and answers to questions about school lessons. It shows no advertising.

Qalam never asks for a name, a photo, a phone number or where you live. A learner is a picture and a number, like "Book 27". Questions are kept for 60 days so a teacher can answer them; which lessons were done is kept for 12 months as counts, without a name. Qalam keeps its records in the European Union.

A teacher reads questions and checks answers. To answer some questions and to read photos of sheet answers, Qalam sends them, with no name and nothing else about the learner, to an AI service. Qalam's admin chooses which company's service each class uses. That company may be in another country, such as the United States, and may keep what it is sent for a limited time, as its own terms say, for example to check for misuse.
You can stop at any time: Settings, then "Stop sharing". What Qalam keeps about this learner is then deleted. Lessons on the phone still work.
